question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a green ball, Claire has a red ball, Dave has a black ball, Eve has a brown ball, Fred has a teal ball, and Gertrude has a white ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Finally, Claire and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) green ball
(C) red ball
(D) black ball
(E) brown ball
(F) teal ball
(G) white ball
solution:
Holder order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: purple | green | red | black | brown | teal | white
1. Fred ↔ Gertrude: purple | green | red | black | brown | white | teal
2. Alice ↔ Fred: white | green | red | black | brown | purple | teal
3. Gertrude ↔ Bob: white | teal | red | black | brown | purple | green
4. Bob ↔ Dave: white | black | red | teal | brown | purple | green
5. Claire ↔ Eve: white | black | brown | teal | red | purple | green
6. Bob ↔ Dave: white | teal | brown | black | red | purple | green
7. Claire ↔ Dave: white | teal | black | brown | red | purple | green
Fred holds the purple ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
